Dubai Districts & Communities

Complete list of Dubai's geographical areas, districts and communities.
Updated 15 Aug 2026

Most Popular
Name A-Z
Name Z-A

DubaiLand
A 107 square mile master-planned site comprising 26 developments including Arabian Ranches, Dubai Sports City and Falcon City of Wonders.

Dubai Marina
The 3km-long, densely populated Marina is encircled by 180 residential skyscrapers, hotels, a mall, a cinema, cafés and restaurants.

Mohammed Bin Rashid City
MBR City is a vast project under way on the land south of Business Bay. The 10,800 hectare site is 20 percent larger than Manhattan.

Business Bay
A new regional business hub with office and residential towers, landscaped gardens and a network of roads and waterways. 

Jumeirah Village Circle
A freehold master development divided into six districts, already containing over 350 towers or townhouse rows and 33 landscaped parks.

Downtown Dubai
A huge residential and commercial development. Home to Dubai landmarks - Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Mall, the Dubai Fountain and Dubai Opera.

Meydan
A 40 million square foot development underway in MBR City, home to the world famous Meydan Race Course which  hosts the annual Dubai Cup.

Jebel Ali First
A coastal district to the South of Dubai and home to Palm Jebel Ali and Jebel Ali Port, the largest marine terminal in the Middle East.

Dubai Hills Estate
A ‘city within the city’. A series of unique neighbourhoods in MBR City set around an 18-hole championship golf course.

Palm Jumeirah
The biggest land reclamation project on earth. A man-made island in the shape of a palm tree fringed with beach-side villas.

Meydan One
A proposed district in MBR CIty covering an area of five million square metres and containing five world record-breaking developments.

Al Furjan
A 560-hectare residential development close to Discovery Gardens and Ibn Battuta Mall. 800 villas and 335 apartments have been delivered.

Dubai Creek Harbour
A new six-million square metre mega-city taking shape at The Lagoons near the Ras Al Khor wildlife sanctuary on Dubai Creek.

Jumeirah Lakes Towers
87 towers arranged in clusters around three lakes and a park, comprising commercial, residential, hotels, shops and leisure facilities. 

Emirates Living
One of the most desirable residential neighbourhoods, combining the exclusive Emirates Hills with six family-oriented communities.

Dubai South
A huge development including Residential, Commercial, Logistics and Aviation districts surrounding the Al Maktoum International Airport.

Sobha Hartland
An eight million square foot mixed-use development in Mohammed Bin Rashid City containing apartments, duplexes, townhouses and villas.

Creek Island
A residential district in Dubai Creek Harbour. Buildings include Dubai Creek Residences, Creekside 18 and Harbour Views.

Damac Hills
A gated community with opulent villas and apartments dotted around the Trump International Golf Club and 40 hectares of parkland.

Dubai Harbour
The 20 million sq ft waterfront development between Jumeirah Beach Residence and Palm Jumeirah includes a marina and a cruise port.

Damac Lagoons
A masterplanned residential community containing villas and townhouses insterspersed with man-made azure blue lagoons and waterways.

Jumeirah Village Triangle
A residential development of small villas and townhouses with large gardens. Apartment blocks are situated on the edges of the district.

Emaar Beachfront
Emaar Beachfront is a new waterfront residential community on the north stretch of Dubai Harbour, located in the bay opposite Mina Seyahi.

Jumeirah Beach Residence
The biggest residential quarter in the world - 35 towers able to house 15,000 people on a 1.7km stretch between Dubai Marina and the sea.

Al Jaddaf
Home to hotels, apartments, shops, leisure facilities, the 80-storey residential D1 tower and the five-star super opulent Palzzo Versace.

Al Wasl
An established residential community benefitting from new retail and leisure developments including City Walk, Galleria Mall and Box Park.

Tilal Al Ghaf
Seven communities surrounding a 70,000 square metre lagoon with 400 metres of open beachfront, interconnected parks and picnic grounds.

Deira
A genuine Middle Eastern township, with its narrow streets, markets and bustling souks selling spices, gold, perfume and electronic goods.

Bur Dubai
Villas and low-rise apartments abound in this historic district on the banks of Dubai Creek across the water from Deira.

Sports City
A residential district built around five major sports venues. The residences consist of apartments, townhouses and villas.

Arabian Ranches 3
An extension of the existing Arabian Ranches community with many outdoor facilities aimed at families with young children and teenagers.

Town Square
A residential community being built in DubaiLand containing 3,500 townhouses, 18,000 apartments, and 600 shops and restaurants.

Arjan
A freehold development project in DubaiLand, designed to include office, retail and hotel space plus apartments to house 67,000 people.

The Opera District
An area dedicated to the arts, culture and events, featuring luxury hotels and apartments, a retail plaza, recreational spaces and parks.

Damac Hills 2
A secluded residential development in the desert of south DubaiLand, promising cleaner air and naturally cooler temperatures.

Dubai Islands
A waterfront city off the coast of Deira containing hotels, resorts, serviced apartments, mixed-use buildings and waterside homes.

The Springs
An established, gated community of terraced villas and town houses with a quiet and friendly atmosphere. Inland from Dubai Marina.

The Valley
A new desert-themed collection of villas with a Town Centre containing indoor and outdoor shops, a farmers' market, cafes and restaurants.

Healthcare City Phase 2
A wellness centre providing long-term care, spa resorts, sports medicine facilities, waterfront residences and nutrition centres in Jadaf.

DubaiLand Residence Complex
DubaiLand Residence Complex is a residential community in Wadi Al Safa 5.

Maritime City
A world-class maritime service facility and industrial business zone covering 2.3 million square metres on a man-made peninsula.

Emaar South
A new golf-course development with more than 15,000 homes comprising villas, tiered townhomes, town houses and apartments.

Umm Suqeim
Expatriates and Emiratis live side-by-side in this older, more established area. It's even peaceful once you get off the beaten track.

Jumeirah 1
Jumeirah 1 is a mixed-use district in Dubai

Dubai South Residential District
Dubai South Residential District is a residential community in Dubai South.

Studio City
A full scale film and TV production centre with associated residential and hotel accommodation. Much of the area is still desert.

Dubai Production City
A business free zone geared towards companies specialising in graphic art, printing, publishing, packaging and media production.

Nad Al Sheba 1
Nad Al Sheba 1 is a district in Meydan.

Motor City
A development in DubaiLand comprising two residential areas and a business park set around a Formula 1 race track. 

Al Sufouh 2
Al Sufouh 2 is a district in Dubai

Azizi Riviera
A residential development consisting of 69 mid-rise residential buildings and two hotels situated alongside a crystal lagoon in Meydan One.

District One
A residential district in MBR City built around the Crystal Lagoon, fringed by man-made beaches and surrounded by parkland.

Dubai Media City
A mixed-use business park in a media and information technology freezone, with cafes, banks, pharmacies and car hire facilities nearby.

Umm Suqeim 3
Umm Suqeim 3 is a district in Umm Suqeim.

Dubai International Financial Centre
The financial quarter of Dubai comprising commercial, retail and residential districts, all three linked by a retail corridor

Mirdif
A residential district of three gated villa communities in north-east Dubai, about 10km from Deira City Centre and close to the airport.

Madinat Jumeirah Living
A group of freehold residences opposite the Burj Al Arab, set amongst lush landscapes and wadis, wind towers and shaded walkways.

Peninsula Business Bay
A waterfront residential district under construction in Business Bay. The project covers an area of 1 million square feet.

Arabian Ranches
A popular, self contained suburban community development comprising 4,000 townhouses and villas plus a supermarket and local shops.

Za'abeel
Za'abeel is a district in Bur Dubai.

Trade Centre First
A narrow district on the north-western side of Sheikh Zayed Road adjacent to Satwa, home to some of the tallest skyscrapers in Dubai.

Majan
Majan is a residential community in Wadi Al Safa 3.

The Views
Ten clusters of apartment towers and villas set around a lake, with lake views on one side and views over the golf course on the other.

Bu Kadra
Bu Kadra is a mixed-use district in Meydan.

City Walk
A stylish, vibrant town-centre community combining residential, shopping, dining and attractions in the heart of the Jumeirah district.

Jumeirah Golf Estates
A collection of 13 luxury estates set around two 18-hole golf courses that have hosted the Dubai World Championship since 2008.

Al Furjan West
Al Furjan West is a residential community in Al Furjan. It is currently under development.

Discovery Gardens
Low rise apartment blocks with over 26,000 affordable studios and apartments surrounded by established gardens and community areas. 

Mudon
A housing development on the edge of the desert in DubaiLand consisting of several neighbourhoods of villas and townhouses. 

The Greens
An established development alongside The Emirates Golf Club. The residential accommodation is housed in ten mid-rise complexes.

Reem
Located in DubaiLand, this master-development is one of the first gated communities in Dubai to incorporate a large central park.

Dubai Science Park
A government sponsored commercial zone and licensing body which caters for the pharmaceutical and medical equipment manufacturing sector.

Arabian Ranches 2
Arabian Ranches 2 is a masterplanned community in Wadi Al Safa 7.

Dubai Silicon Oasis
A state of the art technology park and free zone. Offices, warehouses and manufacturing plus apartments, town houses and villas.

Sobha Hartland 2
Sobha Hartland 2 is a residential community in Bu Kadra. It is currently under development.

The Meadows
Over 1,800 villas set among mature tree-lined streets and scenic lakes, with playgrounds, swimming pools and a community centre.

The Pulse
One of the first two communities to be built in the residential district at Dubai South, near Al Maktoum International Airport.

Culture Village
A development overlooking the Dubai Creek, home to the exclusive Palazzo Versace, apartment buildings, shops and exhibition centres.

Dubai Investments Park
A mixed-use complex consisting of three major zones - an industrial complex, a commercial complex and seven residential communities.

Villanova
A residential district of affordable homes comprising three clusters of Mediterranean style houses, apartments and detached villas.

Expo City Dubai
A 430-hectare site in Jebel Ali comprising the 2 square kilometre Expo 2020 site surrounded by residential, hospitality and logistics zones.

La Mer
A beachfront development with shopping, dining and entertainment areas stretching out to sea between Pearl Jumeirah and Jumeirah Bay.

Jumeirah Park
Jumeirah Park is a family-orientated residential community of 2,000 family villas, surrounded by parks and green spaces.

Wadi Al Safa 2
Wadi Al Safa 2 is a mixed-use district in DubaiLand.

Bluewaters Island
An island off the Jumeirah Beach Residence coast containing sleek residential, hospitality and retail, plus the Ain Dubai Ferris Wheel.

Wasl Gate
A huge new development containing apartments, townhouses, businesses, restaurants and shops in Jebel Ali, close to Energy metro station.

Jebel Ali Industrial Area 2
Jebel Ali Industrial Area 2 is a district in Dubai

Downtown Jebel Ali
Downtown Jebel Ali is a district in Jebel Ali Industrial Area 2.

Trade Centre Second
A narrow corridor on the north-eastern side of Sheikh Zayed Road encompassing the Dubai World Trade Centre, Emirates Towers, DIFC, and some of D…

The Residences at District One
A gated community in Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City - District One located close to the Meydan Racecourse and Grandstand.

Barsha Heights
A bustling residential and commercial district comprising apartment blocks, hotels and hotel apartments. Properties are leasehold only.

MAG City
A mixed-use community consisting of apartment buildings and townhouses, plus a clubhouse, shops, offices and green spaces.

Murooj Al Furjan West
Murooj Al Furjan West is a villa cluster in Al Furjan.

Al Barsha 1
A residential and retail district full of hotels, high-rise apartment buildings, and local shops, pharmacies, cafes and restaurants.

Rashid Yachts & Marina
An AED 25 billion development by the Dubai Creek that combines a new marina with a Riviera-style waterfront residential area.

Port de La Mer
A private residential community on the coast at Jumeirah comprising a marina surrounded by low-rise apartment buildings.

The Fields
The Fields is a residential community in Mohammed Bin Rashid City District 11.

Port Rashid
Port Rashid is a district in Bur Dubai.

Al Safa
The buildings in this well established community include expensive villas and some royal residences as well as shops and restaurants.

Al Barari
Seclusion and opulence with botanic hideaways, landscaped lakes and freshwater streams. An address which must be seen to be believed.
